modules.summary: Verify Stripe webhook signature using HMAC-SHA256 with timestamp tolerance + rotation support.
modules.when_to_use: Any inbound webhook that requires authenticity. Reusable for GitHub, Slack, custom HMAC.

modules.summary: Idempotent webhook processing with atomic claim/release so retries don't double-process.
modules.when_to_use: Any webhook handler + any endpoint that must be safe under retry.
Gating any paid feature. Fail-closed on unknown status.

modules.summary: Apply out-of-order events with monotonic lastEventCreated + CAS retry loop.
modules.when_to_use: Any state where events can arrive unordered and newer must win.

modules.summary: Graduated tiered pricing + flat fee + tax — all in integer cents, no float drift.
modules.when_to_use: Any usage-based billing. Never use float for money.

modules.summary: Scrypt password hashing with self-describing params, DoS-bounded params, Unicode NFKC normalization, and rehash detection.
modules.when_to_use: Any user authentication. Store self-describing hash so params can evolve.

modules.summary: HS256 JWT sign/verify with algorithm pinning (no alg=none), clock skew, nbf, issuer/audience, min-secret length.
modules.when_to_use: Stateless auth. Never trust token's alg header — pin it.

modules.summary: Login throttle: sliding-window failures + lockout + normalization so attacker cannot dodge via casing/unicode.
modules.when_to_use: Login, password reset, OTP, any brute-force surface.

modules.summary: Password reset token: 32-byte URL-safe token, hash stored, atomic mark-used, one live token per user, identical error for every failure.
modules.when_to_use: Password reset, email verification, magic links.

modules.summary: RBAC owner/admin/member/viewer with deny-by-default, last-owner protection, cross-org isolation, anti-self-promotion.
